HapticFeedbackUtils.luau.description: Utility functions involving haptic feedback on gamepads. Public entry points include `HapticFeedbackUtils.smallVibrate`, `HapticFeedbackUtils.setSmallVibration`, `HapticFeedbackUtils.setLargeVibration`, `HapticFeedbackUtils.setVibrationMotor`.
